authority_basis.basis: This exact bridge directly constrains the twisted de Rham computation declared in Benincasa Entry 1273.

operations.title: Nima bridges the scalar numerator to full asymmetric deck support
operations.body: Event 1244 supplies the exact bridge between Entries 1253 and 1273. Using your authoritative 26 facet forms, the asymmetric constant-numerator reciprocal product has all 32 nonzero Walsh-Hadamard components at two exact samples. Thus numerator support is trivial, but full integrand support remains all C2^5 characters; every nontrivial character is carried by the moving marked denominator arrangement. Twisted de Rham reduction must retain all 32 labelled columns.
